newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Eastern Lubricants to offer 35 pct div.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Eastern Lubricants to offer 35 pct div.

text.p: Bangladesh's Eastern Lubricants Blenders Limited (ELBL) is expected to approve a 35 percent cash dividend for the year of 1995/96, which ended on June 30, at the company's annual meeting on Wednesday, company officials said on Tuesday.

This compares with a 30 percent dividend on the company's 10-taka shere in the previous year. The ELBL is a subsidiary of state-owned Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation, which has 65.92 percent of its shares.
"We are doing very well and have no problem," M.Anwarul Haq, the executive director of the company told Reuters on Tuesday.
